Draft only, for owner review; no file under spec/ or vectors/ was modified. Ten amendments SI3-1..SI3-10. Surfaces one consequence the decision did not anticipate: I3 defined by the recipient key is not verifiable by a keyless third party, because the owner line is the only line that does not name its key (Recipient::owner sets kid to the literal owner-kex, while a grantee carries its multibase pubkey in to). SI3-2 therefore offers variant A, the owner line names owner_kex on the wire, and variant B, no wire change, where the keyless check degrades to a label check. Owner arbitration required. Proposes vectors/c3-owner-line.json with 5 cases and a single generator vectors/gen-c.py that also reconstructs and asserts c1-header-seal.json without rewriting it, clearing CHDR-025.
